text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The sound of the waves is so pleasing to
the ear—— 
It sounds just like cheering… 
Cheering meant for me.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
——Now come on!
Let's fish and fish and fish some more! 
We'll make "Fishing Royce-chan" my new
angle!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
…Is fishing always this slow!? 
This is even less time efficient than I
thought it would be…!
choice_data_list: The slowness is what makes it fun.
The slowness is what makes it fun.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Nghh… This doesn't have enough impact to be
my new angle… 
Right.
Next time we'll focus on visual impact!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
What do you think about "Fighting Beauty
Royce-chan"? 
SEIYAAHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Assistant Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Your agility shines like a diamond in
the rough! 
After ten years of training,
you'll be a top-class fighter…!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ten years… 
Osu! I see! Goodbye!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I know it's not as simple as dipping my toes
in something and making it my new angle—— 
But still,
all these options are too inefficient…!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm calling a strategy meeting. 
We need to adjust our research methods and
update our priors.

Even in the face of failure,
Royce and Royce would never waver. 
She may have been my student,
but I had to look up to her tenacity.

But our search for a new angle had a lot of
points for concern. 
Maybe there was another way we could keep
things fresh——

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
The Instant Freeze-Dried Food Fest is
happening now! Entry is free. Please,
come on by!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: …Did she say "instant freeze-dried food"?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You could say that. 
It's time-efficient to prepare,
so I eat it all the time.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm always buying things like instant
vegetable soup in bulk. 
Would you like to try some?

It made sense,
given how much she cared about time efficiency.
But the fact that it extended to her eating
habits, too… 
…I learned a little something new about
her——

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Did you think of something!?
choice_data_list: Why not make THIS your new angle?
Why not make THIS your new angle?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
They've got a lot more visitors than I
expected. 
It looks like I'll be able show off some of
my charm as an instant food specialist.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You've got some good ideas,
Trainer. 
I never would've come up with "knowledgeable
about instant food" as a new angle.
choice_data_list: The problem now is how to show it.
The problem now is how to show it.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Leave that to me. I've got a plan.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Your store's vegetable soup is a personal
favorite of mine. 
It always comes in handy whenever I need
something to eat during training breaks.

text_block_list.name: Store Staff
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! 
Aw man,
knowing that even athletes love our stuff
is enough to make me cry!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's an incredible product that can provide
all the necessary nutrients in just a few
short moments. 
I only wish more people could understand
how lovely it is…

text_block_list.name: Store Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh…! 
In that case,
how'd you like to help us advertise!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Why, I'd love to ♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ahem… Hey,
everyone! Are you tired of cooking and cooking,
day in and day out? Well, I'm Royce and Royce,
and I'm here to introduce you to a meal you
can make in a snap♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
See this soup packed with veggies?
W-W-W-W-Wow! 
Just add hot water,
and it's done in a minute!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's made with a very special freeze-drying
technique! 
This soup is every bit as delicious and
nutritious as veggies fresh from the farm!

text_block_list.name: Housewife
text_block_list.text:
Hmm… It does look delicious… 
But our little one doesn't like eating
greens…

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
For the picky eater kids,
we have a soup with great big chunks of
sweet potato!
It's an excellent source of fiber ♪ 
Perfect for a mid-homework snack!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And that's it for Royce and Royce's
Recommendation Corner. 
Thank you so much for listening～♪

text_block_list.name: Office Worker
text_block_list.text:
Royce-san's a racer, isn't she? 
I didn't know she knew about this stuff,
too…

text_block_list.name: Housewife
text_block_list.text:
Are you on Umatter? 
I'd love it if you posted things like
this～♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
This is it… Everything just clicked! 
Now I see.
My new angle can be something I've had all
along, but don't usually let show.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
But—— This still isn't enough. 
There's only so many hidden sides of myself
I can show before go back to being stale.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Think, Royce, think! Think outside the box,
just like Trainer did——

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
! Eureka!! 
…Trainer, let's go to the bookstore!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fact number one about me is that I'm
intelligence incarnate! 
And we're going to show off that intelligence
in a brand new way!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Presentation is key. 
There's no novelty in framing myself as just
a good study.

Her appreciation for efficiency led us to
her knowledge about instant foods.
So by that logic,
there must be something her studying skills
can lead us to.
choice_data_list: Anything special you use to study?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: That's it!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
——That's our proposal for an advice event
on stationery for test-takers.
Would you be willing to approve?

text_block_list.name: Bookstore Employee
text_block_list.text:
Of course. In fact,
we would very much appreciate it. 
It's exam season,
so we have more students coming to the
store.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You can leave them to us. 
We'll have your store packed to the brim!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
When I focus, I tense up… 
Before I know it,
my hand's all tired from gripping the pen…

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
First you need to change how you hold your
pen. 
Tilt it toward yourself,
and support it with the base of your index
finger.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And here I have a special pen that'll reduce
the stress on your hand.
It's called a "Grip Teacher"! 
Go on, give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Wait… I can write smoothly… W-Wow! 
You're a paper and pen specialist!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
She's a good student,
so she's always working hard and coming up
with new techniques… Um, Royce-san,
could you please tell me what flash cards
are best to use?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Of course! But one at a time, okay? 
I'll be sure to find the perfect fit for
each and every one of you ♪
On our way back from the event——

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Take a look at this! 
I've got the housewife and student demographics
following me now!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's happening, it's happening,
it's really happening…! 
Next I just need to show off a new angle
aimed at the fans, and then——
choice_data_list: No more staleness! You go, Royce!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Heehee. But you're the real MVP today.
I never thought I needed to show those sides
of me,
but they turned out to be fresh new angles.
What a great idea.

If it meant making a racer's dream come true,
I'd do everything I could.
But it was more than that——
choice_data_list: I'm here for you, no matter what.
I'm here for you, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
choice_data_list: We should go before it gets dark.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Right…

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (…For me…)
